name: Alpine Art Center
description: An Alpine event center combining an art gallery, sculpture park, gardens and water features, with indoor and outdoor ceremony locations, an included banquet-room setup and in-house catering.

Features > Outdoors.wording: Indoor and outdoor ceremony sites; gardens

items.label: Description
items.value: An Alpine event center combining an art gallery, sculpture park, gardens and water features, with indoor and outdoor ceremony locations, an included banquet-room setup and in-house catering.

items.label: Address
items.value: 450 S Alpine Hwy, Suite 100, Alpine, UT 84004

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Every rental includes: banquet room, 10 round tables, 2 banquet tables, 80 teak chairs, cake table, serving tables, cabaret tables, sign-in table, drink table, 3 easels, projector, event host, exclusive garden and gallery access, centerpieces, large chandelier, bride and groom rooms, prep kitchen, fridge, ice machine, wireless microphone, speaker system, baby grand piano, linens, setup and takedown
Indoor ceremony — $350
Outdoor ceremony — $350
Bubble send-off — $75
Streamer send-off — $50
Fiber-optic wand send-off — $50
Additional 60-inch round table with 8 chairs and linens — $35
Cabaret table — $22
Rectangle table — $24
4-foot sweetheart table — $22
Additional linens — $10
Additional runners — $8
Additional time — $250/hour; after 10pm — $350/hour
Alcohol charge — $400
Cake cutting service — $65

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
$1,000 non-refundable payment reserves the date
Balance due 60 days before the event
Final payments (add-ons, catering) due 4 weeks before
All payments non-refundable
$500 transfer fee to move the date
Cancelling 60 days or less before the event: full rental due

items.label: Outdoors
items.value: Indoor and outdoor ceremony sites; gardens

items.label: Indoor
items.value: Price: $350 · Includes: chair setup/takedown; rehearsal; staff to play music

items.label: Outdoor
items.value: Price: $350 · Includes: black wrought iron chairs; chair setup/takedown; rehearsal; staff to play music

items.label: Included items
items.value:
10 60-inch round tables
2 8-foot banquet tables
80 Italian teak chairs
Cake table
2 serving tables
2 cabaret tables
Sign-in table
Drink table
3 floor easels
Projector (HDMI)
Centerpiece options
Large chandelier
Baby grand piano
10 floor-length linens, overlays and table runners
Personalized sign at entrance
Birdcage

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value:
Included: set-up and take-down of tables and chairs, and venue cleanup
Self-catering parties must empty trash and wipe counters ($300 fee if not)

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Yes
Speaker system
Wireless microphone
Projector

items.label: For rent
items.value:
Additional 60-inch round table with 8 chairs and linens — $35
Cabaret table — $22
Rectangle table — $24
4-foot sweetheart table — $22
Additional linens — $10
Additional runners — $8

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Art gallery
Sculpture park
Gardens
Water features and fountains
Gazebo
Pergola
Baby grand piano
Indoor and outdoor ceremony locations

items.label: Catering
items.value:
In-house catering: plated meals $20.95-$29.95 per person; buffet items priced per 100 guests
Self-catering allowed (own food or caterer, under the self-catering policy)

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Kitchen: sinks, counter tops, serving carts, buffet tables, ice maker, refrigerator, trash cans and liners
Not available: ovens, stoves, freezers, utensils, silverware, glassware

items.label: Alcohol
items.value:
$400 alcohol charge (includes table, chilling, ice machine use and extra clean-up)
Licensed, insured bartender from the Center's required list (COPA, The Bar Project, Cheers & Swizzles)
Client furnishes the alcohol

items.label: Plated per person
items.value: Range: $20.95-$29.95 · Examples: Chicken cordon bleu: $29.95 · Spaghetti with marinara: $20.95 · Baron of beef: $26.95

items.label: Buffet
items.value: Unit: per 100 guests · Minimum: 100 · Examples: Raspberry lemonade: $255 · Soda bar: $595 · Croissants: $575

items.label: Sparklers
items.value:
No (illegal at this location)
Fiber-optic wand send-off offered instead — $50
